question: Ada berapa proyek yang berstatus berjalan?
ref_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS jumlah FROM proyek WHERE status = 'berjalan'
ref_cypher: MATCH (p:Proyek) WHERE p.status = 'berjalan' RETURN count(p) AS jumlah

question: Siapa pegawai dengan gaji pokok tertinggi?
ref_sql: SELECT nama, gaji_pokok FROM pegawai ORDER BY gaji_pokok DESC LIMIT 1
ref_cypher: MATCH (p:Pegawai) RETURN p.nama AS nama, p.gaji_pokok AS gaji_pokok ORDER BY gaji_pokok DESC LIMIT 1

question: Berapa jumlah pegawai di setiap unit?
ref_sql: SELECT u.nama_unit, COUNT(*) AS jumlah FROM pegawai p JOIN unit u ON p.unit_id = u.unit_id GROUP BY u.nama_unit
ref_cypher: MATCH (p:Pegawai)-[:UNIT]->(u:Unit) RETURN u.nama_unit AS nama_unit, count(p) AS jumlah

question: Unit mana yang memiliki total anggaran proyek paling besar?
ref_sql: SELECT u.nama_unit, SUM(p.anggaran) AS total FROM proyek p JOIN unit u ON p.unit_id = u.unit_id GROUP BY u.nama_unit ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1
ref_cypher: MATCH (p:Proyek)-[:UNIT]->(u:Unit) RETURN u.nama_unit AS nama_unit, sum(p.anggaran) AS total ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1
